faq.question: How do I subscribe to the 3GB High-volume internet pack?
faq.answer:
Azercell gives you 3 easy ways to subscribe:
Subscribe by SMS
SMS 3 to 2525 .
SMSs sent from a Prepaid subscriber to 2525 are free.
Each SMS from a postpaid subscriber to 2525 costs 0.01 AZN.
Subscribe by USSD Code
Dial * 100*3#YES on your phone.
Subscribe by "Azercell" app
You can also order an internet pack through the "Azercell" app. Dial *110# to get a direct download link to the app (available on Android and iOS).

faq.question: How to deactivate the high-volume internet package?
faq.answer: To deactivate the high-volume internet package, prepaid and postpaid subscribers should send stop ay or 0 to 2525 or dial *100*0#YES . In this case, the pack is canceled immediately. When the high-volume package subscription is canceled, the remaining internet is completely reset and internet usage is calculated according to the current tariff plan.

faq.question: Is it possible to cancel the automatic renewal of the high-volume internet package?
faq.answer: It is enough to dial *100*00#YES to cancel automatic renewal of the high-volume internet pack.

faq.question: What happens when the internet traffic provided before the expiration of the pack is fully used?
faq.answer:
Internet access will be deactivated at the end of the validity period or billing cycle of the tariff plan. The subscriber will be redirected to the internet.azercell.com page to activate a new internet pack.
The main advantage of this service is the convenience of an automatic renewal reminder when you have used up your data balance. In such cases, the subscriber is redirected to the download page to continue using the mobile Internet.
After redirection the subscriber can choose between three option:
Renew the existing pack
Order a new larger pack
Continue to use the Internet without pack (1 MB – 0.05 AZN)

faq.question: Can I order multiple internet packs on the same day?
faq.answer:
You are free to purchase multiple packs on the same day.
If you wish to purchase a pack of a volume less than your current pack, you must use up at least 95% of the data from the current pack first.
As of 03.04.2019, there are no restrictions on purchasing a pack of a volume larger than your current pack.

faq.question: Is the high-volume subscription to the current internet pack canceled, when you activate “Gündəlik”, “Limitsiz saat” or “Limitsiz həftəsonu” internet packs?
faq.answer: The subscription to the high-volume internet pack is not canceled, when you connect to daily, hourly packs, as well as to packages for weekends, if a high-volume subscription to the internet pack is activated.

faq.question: Should the current process be repeated every month to resubscribe to the same internet package?
faq.answer:
No, if there are enough funds in the subscriber's account, the system automatically renew the same internet pack at the end of the period of use.
The system will try to update the pack automatically within 90 days, if there are not enough funds in the balance of the prepaid subscriber to renew the internet pack,
The system checks the line within 90 days after blocking incoming and outgoing calls of postpaid subscribers. If the line has not been activated by the end of this period, the subscription is automatically cancelled.

faq.question: How do I get information about my internet pack balance?
faq.answer: To get information about your balance, send a blank (empty) SMS to 2525 or dial *100#YES on your phone. This service is provided free of charge for prepaid subscribers and costs 0.01 AZN for postpaid subscribers.

faq.question: How soon, after subscribing to the new Internet package, will it be activated?
faq.answer: The internet pack is activated for both prepaid and post-paid line subscribers immediately after the request is received.

faq.question: Can I use the new internet pack as soon as I subscribe?
faq.answer: You will receive an SMS with confirmation of internet pack activation before you can use it.

faq.question: Is the unused balance of the internet balance transferred to the next day/month?
faq.answer: All internet packs expire at the end of the day/month (according to the internet pack) and cannot be transferred to the next day/month.

faq.question: Can I use mobile internet when roaming is active?
faq.answer: Yes, it is possible to use the mobile Internet while roaming is active. The internet usage fee will be calculated in accordance with the roaming rates.

faq.question: When is the call itemization (invoice) issued to postpaid subscribers?
faq.answer: Postpaid subscribers who subscribe to the internet pack in the current billing cycle will get the subscription fees in the following bill cycle. If the billing cycle is longer than 30 days, the next invoice may reflect the charges for both the current and next month’s internet packs.

faq.question: What internet speed do I get by ordering a 3GB high-volume internet pack?
faq.answer: When using high-volume data packs, the internet speed isn’t limited and the subscriber can use the maximum network speed.

faq.question: Is there a 20% discount offer for postpaid subscribers who have the status of an individual?
faq.answer: This campaign ended on 27.02.2019.

faq.question: Can I use the high-volume pack benefits together with the benefits from other campaigns?
faq.answer:
As of 08.02.2016, internet bonuses provided within Samsung, Galaxy Tab and Huawei campaigns are used before the bonuses from other packages. This applies to all prepaid and postpaid subscribers using these packs mentioned below:
50MB/500MB/1GB/5GB/10GB internet packs
Daily 500MB internet packs
10GB=10AZN promotion
"GəncOL" tariff
If the data is used up before the end of internet pack respective validity period, internet access will be suspended. The subscriber will then be redirected to www.internet.azercell.com to order a new pack.
High-volume internet packs conditions will be applied once the Data Card and Galaxy Tab campaigns end.
If 50GB High-volume internet pack is active on the balance of the subscriber, it will not be possible to use “Sərfəli 10GB” and “Sərfəli 30GB” high-volume internet packs.

faq.question: Can numbers connected to the internet via a hotspot order a high-volume Internet Pack?
faq.answer: If numbers connected to a hotspot order a high-volume Internet Package from appropriate sources, the service fee will be deducted from the balance of the number sharing the internet. The high-volume internet pack will be active on the main number.

faq.question: Automatic Settings
faq.answer:
For an automatic activation:
To receive the automatic configuration settings simply send an empty SMS message to 9595 (the tariff for sending SMS to 9595 is 0.01 AZN).
You will first receive an informational message, and then, within the next 20 minutes you will receive Internet settings. Received settings should be saved in the phone memory.
Switch off and restart your phone to install the new settings and restore internet access.

faq.question: Manual Settings
faq.answer:
You can also install the updated settings manually. The steps to follow depend on the device that you are using.
Android Phones:
Go to Settings
> Other settings (Other networks, More)
> Mobile networks
> Access Point Names
> New APN
> Name: Type “Azercell Internet”, APN: Type “Internet”
Press ‘Save’ and exit.
Android Tablets:
Go to Settings
> More settings
> Mobile networks
> Access point names
> Create New APN
Name: Azercell internet
APN: internet
APN type: default, hipri/default supl/default
Azercell Internet and Mobile networks must be activated after the configurations are stored in the device memory.
iOS Devices:
Go to Settings
> Mobile network
> Mobile data network
> Apn: Type “Internet”
Switch off and restart the device.
Xiaomi Devices:
Go to Settings
> Sim card and Mobile networks
> Sim card settings
> Azercell
> Access point names
> In the new APN, type “Azercell” in the Name field and “Internet” in the APN field
Check which slot the Azercell SIM is in. Go to Sim Manager> Data Service Network and select the SIM card where the number is located.

plans.name: Unlimited 3 hours

sms.cost: free for prepaid; 0.01 AZN for postpaid

faq.question: How do I subscribe to an Uimited 3 hours internet pack?
faq.answer:
Azercell gives you 3 easy ways to subscribe:
Subscribe by SMS
SMS 3S to 2525 for the Unlimited 3 hours internet pack.
SMSs sent from a prepaid subscriber to 2525 are free.
Each SMS from a postpaid subscriber to 2525 costs 0.01 AZN.
Subscribe by USSD Code
Dial *100*180#YES on your phone for the Unlimited 3 hours internet pack.
Subscribe by "Azercell" app
You can also order an internet pack through the "Azercell" app. Dial *110# to get a direct download link to the app (available on Android and iOS).

faq.question: What internet speeds will I get with this internet data plan?
faq.answer: Subscribers will enjoy unlimited download speed.

faq.question: Can I use multiple internet packs at the same time?
faq.answer: It is only possible to use a single internet pack at a time.

faq.question: What happens at the end of the validity period of the internet pack?
faq.answer:
When the 1 and 3 hour validity period of the data package expires, internet access is immediately suspended and the subscriber is redirected to the internet.azercell.com website.
Internet usage without a package is charged according to the current tariff.

faq.question: I am a corporate Azercell subscriber. Can I purchase any Unlimited hour internet pack?
faq.answer: Corporate subscribers may purchase any Unlimited hour pack except the Unlimited 6-hour pack.

faq.question: How do I deactivate "Unlimited 3 hour" internet pack?
faq.answer: The pack can be deactivated through "Azercell" app. Dial *110# to get a direct link to download the app.

faq.question: Can numbers connected to the internet via a hotspot order an internet pack?
faq.answer: If numbers connected to a hotspot order an internet package from appropriate sources, the service fee will be deducted from the balance of the number sharing the internet. The internet pack will be active on the main number.

faq.question: Automatic Settings
faq.answer:
For an automatic activation:
To receive the automatic configuration settings simply send an empty SMS message to 9595 (the tariff for sending SMS to 9595 is 0.01 AZN).
You will first receive an informational message, and then, within the next 20 minutes you will receive Internet settings. Received settings should be saved in the phone memory.
Switch off and restart your phone to install the new settings and restore internet access.

faq.question: Manual Settings
faq.answer:
You can also install the updated settings manually. The steps to follow depend on the device that you are using.
Android Phones:
Go to Settings
> Other settings (Other networks, More)
> Mobile networks
> Access Point Names
> New APN
> Name: Type “Azercell Internet”, APN: Type “Internet”
Press ‘Save’ and exit.
Android Tablets:
Go to Settings
> More settings
> Mobile networks
> Access point names
> Create New APN
